senses.gloss: (b. h. הָלְאָה; cmp. הָאֵל)further on, with prefix ל.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 30:1">Lev. R. s. 30</cite> <he>מן הכא ולה׳ נחל וכ׳</he> (ed. Wil. <he>מן הכא נחל</he>) from now and onward we shall begin a new account.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 2:5:4">Y. R. Hash. II, 58ᵇ</cite> top <he>מן ההוא תרעא דלהל</he> (read <he>ולהלא</he>) from this court session and for all future ones.
